definition.name: Create Walls From Centreline Table
definition.description: Creates exact-thickness single-layer wall types and places walls from a list of [x1,y1,x2,y2,thicknessMm,kind] centreline rows in mm between two levels.
definition.aiDescription: Creates exact-thickness single-layer wall types and places walls from a list of [x1,y1,x2,y2,thicknessMm,kind] centreline rows in mm between two levels.
examples: Create two single-layer wall types (BC_Concrete 200mm, BC_Partition 100mm) and place 165 Block C walls on Level 2 with top constraint Level 3, bottom-left building corner at the project origin.
definition.author: mrafaatFK2S3
